visit.heading: GETTING HERE
visit.lede: Come any time we are open. No booking, no forms: say it is your first visit at the desk.
visit.landmarks: 3 minutes from Vake Park, 3 minutes' walk from Axis Towers.
visit.map_alt: Map of Vake with Fitto Club marked on Ilo Mosashvili Street
visit.video_button: WATCH THE WALK TO THE ENTRANCE
steps: The walk in the video starts at the underpass and follows Ilo Mosashvili Street.
Look for the orange Fitto Club neon sign above a glass door at number 9.
The club is one floor down. Reception is straight ahead.
visit.poster_alt: The glass entrance door of Fitto Club with the orange sign

home.title: Fitto Club: fitness club in Vake, Tbilisi. First visit free
home.description: A small, fully equipped gym in Vake with coaches who speak Georgian, English and Russian. Your first visit is free, no booking needed.
home.eyebrow: FITNESS CLUB IN VAKE · 3 MIN FROM VAKE PARK
home.hero_photo_alt: The Fitto Club gym floor under pink and blue light columns
home.first_lede: Nobody will make you do burpees at the door. Here is exactly what happens.

first_steps.title: Come when we are open
first_steps.text: No booking and no form. Any day, any time within opening hours.

first_steps.title: Find the glass door
first_steps.text: 9 Ilo Mosashvili Street, under the orange neon sign. There is a 20-second video of the walk below.

first_steps.title: Say hi at the desk
first_steps.text: The admin speaks Georgian, English and Russian, shows you round and tells you which coach is on the floor.

first_steps.title: Bring a towel
first_steps.text: Sports clothes, clean shoes and your own towel. Water is on us.

home.facade_alt: The street entrance of Fitto Club with the orange neon logo
home.price_text: Every membership comes with one personal training session as a gift.
home.coaches_lede: Coaches with a background in sport, who speak Georgian, English, Russian, Spanish and German.
home.zones_heading: A SMALL CLUB WITH EVERYTHING CLOSE
home.zones_lede: Fitto is not a hangar. It is compact, it can get busy at peak hours, and the coach knows your name. The zones are separate, so the rings never wait for the treadmill.
home.zones_link: All zones on the About page
home.massage_text: Full body, back, legs, face. From %d GEL.
home.guests_line: France's rugby team trained here before the World Cup, and Kanye dropped in once. Everyone else lives round the corner.

memberships.heading: MEMBERSHIPS
memberships.lede: Prices in GEL. No joining fee, no small print.
memberships.free_text: Try the club before you pay anything. Come in, train, then decide.
memberships.single_text: One day in the club, any time we are open.
included: Gym floor, CrossFit zone and cardio
Changing rooms with code-lock lockers and showers
A lounge to sit down after training
Towels are not provided, so bring your own
memberships.pt_text: From 50 GEL an hour. Every coach sets their own price.

about.title: About Fitto Club: a fitness club in Vake since 2025
about.description: Fitto Club opened in Vake in July 2025. Founded by coach Otar Chkadua. Zones, events, partners and how to find us.
about.heading: ABOUT THE CLUB
story: Fitto Club opened in July 2025 in Vake, three minutes from the park.
It was started by coach Otar Chkadua, who had trained people for eleven years before building a place to do it properly. The idea: train sensibly, effectively and with results, not to exhaustion.
